column1: # fork-patch-signatures.tsv — COMPLETENESS map of EVERY fork patch in the live gt.
# verify-fork-patches.sh derives the patch set from git (`git rev-list --no-merges
# <merge-base origin/main..LIVE>..LIVE`) and REQUIRES every commit to appear here,
# as a signature (must be present in the binary) OR an explicit `waive` (accounted
# for, no distinct binary signature). An UNMAPPED commit => RED BUILD ("unguarded
# patch"). A mapped signature MISSING from the binary => RED BUILD ("dropped patch").
# This makes coverage provably complete (diffed against git), not hand-maintained —
# fixing the earlier presence-only guard's false green (hq-qk6x).
#   sym   value = `go tool nm` symbol substring — MUST be in binary
#   str   value = `strings` substring          — MUST be in binary
#   tool  value = go toolchain substring        — `go version <bin>` MUST contain it
#   waive value = reason                        — commit accounted-for, no distinct signature
# When you land a new fork patch: add its row (signature preferred; waive only when
# there is genuinely no distinct binary marker). Leaving a new commit unmapped is a RED BUILD.
